Shri S.A.Mohta, Advocate for the applicant.
Shri S.D.Shirpurkar, App for the respondents.

Coram : P. N. Deshmukh &
 Pushpa V. Ganediwala, Jj.
Shri Shirpurkar, learned APP waives notice on behalf of respondent nos.1 and 2 and seeks time to file affidavit-in-reply.

The learned counsel for the applicant prays for interim order in terms of prayer clause (IV) of the petition and has pointed out the order passed in Writ Petition No.2/2019 in the case of (Tushar Subhash Getam and Others Vs. State of Maharashtra) by the Aurangabad Bench of the Bombay High Court.

entities.text: Tushar Subhash Getam and Others Vs. State of Maharashtra
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Perusal of the same, prima facie makes out a case for interim relief.

Hence, we pass the following order:
(i) The learned APP on instructions of the Food Safety Officer, Nagpur, submits that in terms of provisions of Section 38(1) (c) proviso of the Food Safety and Standards Mohammad Asif Haji Hussain vs Food Safety Officer, Food And Drug ... on 15 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195873434/
1 Act, 2006, necessary bond with an undertaking would be taken from the applicant herein.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Mohammad Asif Haji Hussain vs Food Safety Officer, Food And Drug
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He further states that, if such bond with the undertaking is executed voluntarily by the applicant, the respondents shall be de-seal the Grocery Shop of the applicant within seven days from the date of execution of bond and undertaking.

(ii) The learned Advocate for the applicant, on instructions, submits that the applicant is ready to execute the bond in terms of Section 38(1) (c) proviso of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and is also ready to file an undertaking to the effect that in future he would not keep contraband articles like Gutkha etc. in his shop and he will not use his shop for apl715.19.odt storing those articles in future.
We further direct that though investigation to continue, charge-sheet shall not be filed without seeking leave of this Court.
